owner: BE-W only services/ticket; BE-0 owns trust/gateway/identity/public launch integration
internalEdge: approval-ticket, TLS and existing Chain authentication/timeout/no-store; never allow gateway-ticket on these routes

routes.semantics: pure query; online EMPLOYEE identity plus current company/read or current engineer object authorization; no title, body, notes or client identity claims

online TICKET_WORK identity/CSRF, current enabled engineer/read/record and IN_PROGRESS current assignment; no pending cancellation; actor->ticket->assignment lock; append reference + version + audit atomically

fields.assignmentId: UUID or null in read context
fields.departmentId: verified numeric ID; approval submission currently uses department CODE, BE-0 identity adapter must map/verify current code, never compare code with numeric ID
fields.commandDigest: lowercase SHA256 generated by approval owner from action/tenant/actor/target/full immutable parameters including previousApplicationId, never hash tokens
fields.referenceState: REGISTERED_INTENT only, never approval-committed or cleanup proof

ordering: P verifies its explicit approval submit capability and stock eligibility, then registers original submission intent BEFORE committing an application/outbox. All P paths including revision submit must use this gate. Ticket proof is not approval capability or a stock reservation. A pure context read is not permission to commit.
cancellation: registration serializes with cancellation under same ticket lock; already terminal/waiting cancel rejects new registration; registered intent makes ordinary direct/approved cancellation fail409 UNSUPPORTED_RELATED_BUSINESS even if approval commit/ACK is unknown. A cancel request may remain pending and be rejected; no cancellation cleanup is asserted. No close/solve/fee-settlement gate added.
recovery: same UUID/actor/ticket/round/assignment/digest replays registration without version/audit changes only with current submission qualification; changed parameters409, other actor404. Unknown result keeps original UUID/body. Intent never expires or disappears on network errors. No release endpoint until owner-coordinated ABORT/freeze/result protocol is implemented; conservative unresolved intent remains a visible integration prerequisite.
grants: runtime SELECT,INSERT on ticket_approval_reference only; no UPDATE/DELETE. Existing bounded ticket_record row_version update and audit insert reused. V9 incrementally creates only owner table; do not rewrite V1-V8.

handoff.BE-0: enable only two exact POST paths on approval-ticket and ticket EdgeFilter; forward already verified Origin for approval entry and identity/CSRF handling; no public internal route; add runtime minimum grant via owned launch/migration integration
handoff.BE-P: wire existing ApprovalAccess submission to explicit approval capability, stock and this durable gate before local application commit; require department-code lookup; retain REGISTERED_INTENT after rollback/unknown until coordinated recovery
handoff.BE-N: P outbox remains same-owner same-physical-transaction; this ticket registration is not a delivery ACK or notification receipt
handoff.BE-S: warehouse/part current tenant active/scope remains stock-owned, never ticket cross-table reads

closureProjection: With any persisted intent close-check reports relatedWorkflows=APPROVAL_INTENT_REGISTERED, approvalIntentCount decimal string, externalOwnerCleanupVerified=false instead of claiming NOT_ENABLED; canClose policy unchanged and no fee-settlement condition. FE-0 must accept this additive truth marker. This does not prove stock/fee cleanup.
